_comment: Phase 20 Event Engine / Line Crossing demo -- 'Traffic light directing traffic' stock footage (data/demo_trafficlight.mp4). The 'correspondences' below are ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY, same as configs/cameras/demo.json's own placeholder -- there is no real-world survey of this stock-footage intersection, so no speed/OVERSPEED claim is made for this camera (see scripts/persist_video.py's --speed-limit, set unreachably high when ingesting this camera specifically so OVERSPEED can never fire against this uncalibrated scale).
